title: fix(mcp): run_action and resume_run answer a throw through the /actions door's one reader
body:

_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XSaaQXQ6J3byqVhvgRU927w)_

domain:server#6 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5pVLKxR5eAhTYetnwR

Fixes #31271

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`/api/v1/actions` 对动作抛错的回答,原来是 runtime 里 catch 块中的一串内联判断,现在抽成 `@objectstack/types` 的一个函数 `actionsDoorAnswerOf`(放在 `/data` 用的 `mapDataError` 旁边);`/actions` 改调它,MCP 的 `run_action` / `resume_run` 也改调它。
- 为什么改:MCP 这两个工具对沙箱动作体不带 code 的 `throw` 直接把带动作体名字的包装文本回给 agent,而 `/actions` 回 `400 HOOK_ABORTED` 加内层那句话;裸 Error、`SQLITE_BUSY`、沙箱崩溃也各不相同。现在两边读同一个函数,不会再分叉。
- 风险与回滚:`/actions` 的回答逐字节不变(runtime 全量 555 个测试文件全绿,现有 pins 一条未改);MCP 这两个工具的错误回答按上表变化;抛出的 `details` 只随拒绝(状态码低于 500)带出,故障(500 及以上)不再带。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/types/src/actions-door-answer.ts`(级联本体,注释随迁),`packages/runtime/src/domains/actions.ts` 的 catch 尾部,`packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts` 的 `errorResultFromThrown`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/mcp exec vitest run src/mcp-coded-refusal.test.ts -t 31271`,预期 17 条全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地(落地前要一次 TIER_DEFAULT 契约复审,因为 `@objectstack/types` 多了一个公开导出)。

## What changes

- **`@objectstack/types`: new `actionsDoorAnswerOf(err, objectName?)` and its `ActionsDoorAnswer` type** (`src/actions-door-answer.ts`, exported from the index beside `data-error-classification`). It is the `/api/v1/actions` door's answer to a thrown value: the arms its catch spelled inline, moved in the same order with the reasons and history each one carried (the sandbox wrapper kept off the wire through `sandboxBusinessMessage`; a sandboxed crash is the `500` fault; a declared status is served through `resolveThrownHttpError` at a `500` fallback; a driver NOT NULL refusal answers `driverNotNullRefusalAnswer`'s arm; an unexpected fault is the sanitised `500`; everything else is the `400` rejection). Arms 3 and 6 answer as the dispatcher answers a thrown value: the closed code, the engine unique class at its wire spelling with the REST arm's context, the demoted `declaredCode`, a declared `userMessage`, and a leaky 5xx sentence withheld. It returns the operator lines the door prints (the full wrapper, the fault line).
- **`@objectstack/runtime` `domains/actions.ts`**: the catch keeps its earned-answer arm (declarative update) and answers everything else through `actionsDoorAnswerOf`, printing its operator lines with the same `[action OBJECT/ACTION]` prefix and building the body with `apiErrorResponse`, the builder the dispatcher's `error` / `errorFromThrown` exits use. Refactor only: no answer moves.
- **`@objectstack/mcp` `errorResultFromThrown`** (`run_action`, `resume_run`) answers through the same function: `{ error: { code, message, status, declaredCode?, userMessage?, details? } }`. The `PERMISSION_DENIED` withhold is kept. #15942's thrown `details` now ride only on a refusal (status below 500), never on a fault, which answers only the door's sanitised envelope. The context the door adds (`fields`, `issues`, the unique arm's `object` / `field`) is not served, as on every other MCP tool.

| `run_action` / `resume_run` caught | Before (main 7c523aa1) | After (= `/actions`) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| code-less sandboxed body abort | bare wrapper text naming the body | `400 HOOK_ABORTED`, the inner sentence |
| bare `Error('socket hang up')` | bare text, no code | `400 VALIDATION_ERROR`, `socket hang up` |
| `SQLITE_BUSY` driver error | `{ code: SQLITE_BUSY, message }`, no status | `400 VALIDATION_ERROR`, `declaredCode: SQLITE_BUSY` |
| sandboxed crash, no code | bare wrapper with `TypeError: boom` | `500 INTERNAL_ERROR`, `Internal server error` |
| sandboxed crash declaring `RECORD_LOCKED` / 409 | same as above | same `500` fault |
| app's own unregistered code `LEAVE_EXHAUSTED` / 409 | `code: LEAVE_EXHAUSTED`, 409 | `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, `declaredCode: LEAVE_EXHAUSTED` |
| a fault (503, or a sandboxed crash) carrying thrown `details` | bare text, no `details` | no `details`, the door's envelope only |
| CONTROL: coded sandboxed refusal `RECORD_LOCKED` / 409 | `RECORD_LOCKED`, inner sentence, 409 | unchanged |
| CONTROL: `ACTION_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED` / 428 with `details` | code, 428, `details` | unchanged |

## Tests

- New `packages/types/src/actions-door-answer.test.ts`: 10 rows, one per arm plus controls (abort, bare Error, driver string code, sandboxed crash with and without a code, in-process crash, coded refusal, declared status with an unregistered code, leaky declared 5xx, `userMessage`, NOT NULL arm).
- `packages/mcp/src/mcp-coded-refusal.test.ts`: new #31271 block, 17 rows (the 5 cases on each tool, each asserting the literal answer AND equality with `actionsDoorAnswerOf` on a fresh copy of the throw, no body name, no `TypeError`, the operator log count; the unregistered `LEAVE_EXHAUSTED` / 409 row on each tool; the fault-with-`details` row on each tool, which also keeps a 428 refusal's `details`; the CONTROL on each tool). Two existing rows move with the behaviour: the #23509 code-less row for the two action tools now pins the door's `400` rejection, and the #31218 bare-message CONTROL excludes them. `mcp-action-confirmation-member.test.ts`: the uncoded-failure row now pins the door's answer.
- Runtime `/actions` pins: unedited, all green.
- Fallout, `packages/cli/test/package-install-local-handlers.integration.test.ts`: the ghost-action `run_action` pin read the old bare text with `String(payload)`. It now reads the envelope: `VALIDATION_ERROR`, `400`, and a message that still says `No handler registered`.

## Acceptance notes

- **The `/actions`-vs-`/data` difference on a driver string code stays.** `/actions` answers `SQLITE_BUSY` `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` with `declaredCode`; `/api/v1/data` answers `500 DATABASE_ERROR`. These tools now answer what `/actions` answers, per the seat ruling; which REST door is right is not decided here.
- **One composition left beside the reader.** The dispatcher's `errorFromThrown` / `error` (`http-dispatcher.ts`, outside this claim's surface) still compose the same `@objectstack/types` pieces for every other dispatcher domain. The `/actions` door no longer goes through them; its bodies are held equal by its existing pins (runtime suite green unedited).
- **`details` on the action tools.** Thrown `details` only, and only on a refusal (status below 500); a fault serves the door's sanitised envelope without them. The door's added context is not served on MCP, as `errorResultWithCode` explains for every tool.
- **A ghost action (declared, no handler).** MCP `run_action` now answers it `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` with `No handler registered…`, because the bridge's `invokeBusinessAction` throws an uncoded error. `POST /api/v1/actions` answers the same action `404` from its routing-miss branch before any handler runs. That producer-side difference is outside this PR.
- **Earned answers.** The declarative-update earned-answer arm stays at the door (it needs the action definition); MCP's `landedWriteResultOrError` already reads it before this renderer.
- **Superseded changeset line.** The pending `31218` changeset says `run_action` and `resume_run` are unchanged by that card; this PR's changeset supersedes that sentence and does not edit it.

## Verification

All on head `7d083983` (base `7c523aa1`); the first round ran on `73bb0469`.

<details><summary>Red first, fix, suites</summary>

- Premise on `7c523aa1`, over `/mcp` (scratch probe, not committed): `run_action` and `resume_run` answered `"action 'demo_body' threw: Error: Not enough leave"`, `"socket hang up"`, `{ code: SQLITE_BUSY, message }` with no status, and the wrapper with `TypeError: boom` for a crash with or without a code; the coded refusal CONTROL answered `RECORD_LOCKED` / `Locked.` / 409.
- Red first: the new pins on the base MCP source, `mcp-coded-refusal.test.ts`: Tests 12 failed | 94 passed (106) (10 new rows, the 2 moved code-less rows; the CONTROLs green). With the fix: 106 passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/mcp test` on `7d083983`: Test Files 60 passed (60), Tests 839 passed (839).
- `packages/cli/test/package-install-local-handlers.integration.test.ts` on `7d083983`: Test Files 1 passed (1), Tests 17 passed (17).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/types test`: Test Files 37 passed (37), Tests 870 passed (870).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime test` (types aliased to source; runtime source identical since `8b4876fb`): Test Files 555 passed (555), Tests 8939 passed, 19 skipped; lock VERDICT command-exit 0. No `/actions` pin edited.
- `typecheck` for `@objectstack/types`, `@objectstack/runtime`, `@objectstack/mcp`: exit 0 (runtime test layer 27 files / 186 errors / 66 pinned signatures held; mcp 6 / 53 / 8 held).
- `eslint --no-inline-config` on all 8 touched `.ts` files across two runs (the 7 of the first run, then the 3 this hop touched): exit 0.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (ablation-replace, restored to HEAD each time)</summary>

- `mcp-http-tools.ts`: the PERMISSION_DENIED line rewritten to answer `errorResult(messageOf(err))` for every throw (bypassing the reader's answer). Mutation landed (anchor 1 to 0, blob 33371b9419a0 to 2b20f1be220e); `mcp-coded-refusal.test.ts` + `mcp-action-confirmation-member.test.ts`: Tests 21 failed | 91 passed (112). Restored: blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- `actions-door-answer.ts`: the sandboxed-crash arm disabled (a condition that is never true, `String("ABL").length` less than 0). Types `actions-door-answer.test.ts`: 1 failed | 9 passed (the crash row); runtime `actions-undeclared-hook-abort-code.test.ts` + `nested-hook-refusal-is-a-rejection.test.ts` (types aliased to source): 1 failed | 11 passed, the `/actions` crash pin, which shows the door answers through the reader. Restored: blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty. Both suites import source; no dist involved.
- Details guard (`mcp-http-tools.ts`): the `status < 500` condition made always true (`|| String("ABL").length > 0`), so thrown `details` ride on every answer. Mutation landed (anchor 1 to 0, blob 91fd3c05eee0 to 5d4314c7940f). `mcp-coded-refusal.test.ts -t 31271`: Tests 2 failed | 15 passed (the fault-with-`details` row on each tool). Restored: blob == HEAD.

</details>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at `7d083983`: 67 commands (the cli test file adds `check:cli-test-child-env`), each run with stdin from `/dev/null`, all exit 0 on the first run. `dispatch-gates --ran`: 67 derived families accounted for, 67 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED. The cli integration suite is not a derived family; the one edited file was run on its own (above). Not run locally (CI): `test:repo`, dogfood shards, type-check lanes.

</details>
